title: The Story of a Bold Tin Soldier
summary: "The Story of a Bold Tin Soldier" by Laura Lee Hope is a children's book written in the early 20th century. The narrative explores themes of bravery, friendship, and the imagination of children, as the toys engage in various make-believe scenarios while waiting for their eventual homes with children. Throughout the book, the soldier hopes for a boy who will care for him, which eventually comes true when a child named Arnold buys him.
